decisions.reason: The sheet preparation module builds on the core postpress offer and still has a page of its own in 2024, which signals results at or near aspiration, and the firm in a growing industry has enough slack to carry it while other 2023 launches were pruned.

The folding add-on unit is close to the established portfolio and has a documented customer installation combining creasing, perforating, cutting and folding in one pass, so it meets aspirations well enough to avoid problemistic search, though its low visibility leaves some risk.
